title: Speed at break
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the block's speed at the lowest point using projectile motion from the landing point.

title: Maximum rope tension
description: Essential: Correctly applies Newton's second law at the lowest point to find the tension from the speed and length.

title: Conveyor belt length
description: Essential: Correctly determines the belt length using kinematics and the final fly-off speed from centripetal condition.

title: New rope length
description: Essential: Correctly solves for the new rope length using projectile conditions and the constraint of landing at the left end.

title: Projectile time analysis
description: Important: Correctly uses vertical free-fall to find the time of flight for the initial or adjusted projectile motion.

title: Fly-off speed condition
description: Important: Correctly applies centripetal force condition at the pulley to find the block's speed when leaving the belt.

title: Friction acceleration
description: Important: Correctly identifies the acceleration on the belt as a = μg, using Newton's second law.

title: Kinematics on belt
description: Important: Correctly applies the kinematic equation (v² = 2aL) to relate speed, acceleration, and belt length.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in force equations (e.g., centripetal force direction) or omits units in final answers.

title: Energy misconception
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses energy conservation for the vertical circle or the belt motion where it does not apply.
